item.name: Scheduler
item.description: Recurring jobs: job types, schedules, manual runs and history. See docs/API_GUIDE.md section 7.

header.description: Enable to act in another company

request.description: What can be scheduled: key, scope (SYSTEM / COMPANY / ANY), required permission, default schedule.

request.description: Next fire times of an unsaved schedule (here: the first Monday of each month at 09:00). Nothing is stored.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Purge sessions every 30 minutes (Postman)",
  "description": "Created from the Postman collection",
  "jobKey": "{{jobKey}}",
  "scope": "SYSTEM",
  "scheduleType": "INTERVAL",
  "interval": "PT30M",
  "maxRetries": 1
}

request.description: scope SYSTEM needs scheduler.system.manage; drop it (default COMPANY) for a job whose scope allows companies.

request.description: Switches to a cron every 10 minutes. Fields left out keep their value; null clears one.

request.description: Audit entries of this schedule, newest first. Needs what reading the schedule needs, plus audit.history.read.

request.description: Queues a run acting as you (202). Optional body: { "parameters": { ... } } to override the schedule's. A second request while one is queued: 409 RUN_ALREADY_QUEUED.

item.name: Document numbering
item.description: Number series and their counters. See docs/API_GUIDE.md section 8. Set documentType to a key from List document types first.

header.description: Enable to act in another company

request.description: What can be numbered: key, parameters a pattern may use, gaplessRequired, default series. Empty until a module declares a document type (none does yet; GL journal entries will be first).

header.description: Enable to act in another company

request.description: A series for {{documentType}}. Left out, isDefault is true when the type has no default yet. Fails with UNKNOWN_DOCUMENT_TYPE until a module declares that type.

header.description: Enable to act in another company

request.description: The company's series, by document type then code. Filter with documentType.

header.description: Enable to act in another company

request.description: One series, with used (it has a counter: pattern, mode and start value are frozen).

item.name: Update series (uses the last version read)

header.description: Enable to act in another company

request.description: Fields left out keep their value. pattern, mode and startValue only while the series is unused (409 NUMBER_SERIES_IN_USE otherwise).

header.description: Enable to act in another company

request.description: Takes the flag off the old default in the same transaction. isDefault: false is refused: make another series the default instead.

header.description: Enable to act in another company

request.description: One counter per combination of parameter values: scope, lastNumber, nextNumber, and next as it will print.

item.name: Set next number (continue an old system)

header.description: Enable to act in another company

request.description: Moves one counter up so its next number is nextNumber; creates it if needed. params: the values of the pattern's parameters ({} when it has none). Lowering a counter is refused (409 COUNTER_CANNOT_DECREASE).

header.description: Enable to act in another company

request.description: CREATED, UPDATED and COUNTER_SET entries, newest first. Needs audit.history.read.

header.description: Enable to act in another company

request.description: Series are never deleted. A disabled series gives no numbers (callers get 409 NUMBER_SERIES_NOT_FOUND).
